title: Demo Time - Slide front matter
description: The front matter properties of a Demo Time slide. Custom layouts, headers and footers can read other properties too. `x-demotime.inheritance` tells how a property in the document front matter applies to the other slides of the file: `always` (every slide), `fallback` (slides that do not set it) or `firstSlide` (only the first slide).

theme.description: The built-in theme of the slide.
theme.markdownDescription: The built-in theme of the slide.

transition.description: The transition to show the slide with. Default: No transition.
transition.markdownDescription: The transition to show the slide with. Default: No transition.

customTheme.description: Path (relative to the workspace folder) or URL of a CSS file with your own theme, which builds on the `theme`.
customTheme.markdownDescription: Path (relative to the workspace folder) or URL of a CSS file with your own theme, which builds on the `theme`.

customLayout.description: Path (relative to the workspace folder) of a Handlebars template with your own layout.
customLayout.markdownDescription: Path (relative to the workspace folder) of a Handlebars template with your own layout.

header.description: Handlebars template for the header of the slide. It can use the front matter properties and the header and footer placeholders. Default: The `demoTime.slideHeaderTemplate` setting.
header.markdownDescription: Handlebars template for the header of the slide. It can use the front matter properties and the header and footer placeholders. Default: The `demoTime.slideHeaderTemplate` setting.

footer.description: Handlebars template for the footer of the slide. It can use the front matter properties and the header and footer placeholders. Default: The `demoTime.slideFooterTemplate` setting.
footer.markdownDescription: Handlebars template for the footer of the slide. It can use the front matter properties and the header and footer placeholders. Default: The `demoTime.slideFooterTemplate` setting.

progress.description: Shows (`true`, `top` or `bottom`) or hides (`false`) the progress bar on the slide. `true` uses the position of the `demoTime.slideProgressBar` setting, or the bottom when the setting is `none`. Default: The `demoTime.slideProgressBar` setting.
progress.markdownDescription: Shows (`true`, `top` or `bottom`) or hides (`false`) the progress bar on the slide. `true` uses the position of the `demoTime.slideProgressBar` setting, or the bottom when the setting is `none`. Default: The `demoTime.slideProgressBar` setting.

title.description: The title of the slide in the slide navigator and overview when the slide has no heading. Header and footer templates can read it with `{{title}}`.
title.markdownDescription: The title of the slide in the slide navigator and overview when the slide has no heading. Header and footer templates can read it with `{{title}}`.

date.description: The date that the `{{date}}` placeholder of header and footer templates shows. Default: Today's date.
date.markdownDescription: The date that the `{{date}}` placeholder of header and footer templates shows. Default: Today's date.

slideTitle.description: Overrides the `{{slideTitle}}` placeholder of header and footer templates. Default: The first heading of the slide.
slideTitle.markdownDescription: Overrides the `{{slideTitle}}` placeholder of header and footer templates. Default: The first heading of the slide.

sceneTitle.description: Overrides the `{{sceneTitle}}` placeholder of header and footer templates. Default: The title of the scene that opens the slide.
sceneTitle.markdownDescription: Overrides the `{{sceneTitle}}` placeholder of header and footer templates. Default: The title of the scene that opens the slide.

actTitle.description: Overrides the `{{actTitle}}` placeholder of header and footer templates. Default: The title of the act that opens the slide.
actTitle.markdownDescription: Overrides the `{{actTitle}}` placeholder of header and footer templates. Default: The title of the act that opens the slide.

presentationTitle.description: Overrides the `{{presentationTitle}}` placeholder of header and footer templates. Default: The `demoTime.presentationTitle` setting, or the name of the workspace folder.
presentationTitle.markdownDescription: Overrides the `{{presentationTitle}}` placeholder of header and footer templates. Default: The `demoTime.presentationTitle` setting, or the name of the workspace folder.

autoAdvanceAfter.description: Goes to the next slide or scene after this number of seconds.
autoAdvanceAfter.markdownDescription: Goes to the next slide or scene after this number of seconds.

hide.description: Skips the slide while presenting. A hidden slide is not counted in the slide numbers.
hide.markdownDescription: Skips the slide while presenting. A hidden slide is not counted in the slide numbers.

autoFit.description: Scales the content down, to at least 50%, when it doesn't fit on the slide.
autoFit.markdownDescription: Scales the content down, to at least 50%, when it doesn't fit on the slide.

image.description: Path (relative to the workspace folder) or URL of an image. The `image-left` and `image-right` layouts show it next to the content, the other layouts as the background of the slide.
image.markdownDescription: Path (relative to the workspace folder) or URL of an image. The `image-left` and `image-right` layouts show it next to the content, the other layouts as the background of the slide.

background.description: The background of the slide: a CSS colour (`"#1e3a8a"`), a gradient (`"linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a8a, #9333ea)"`), or the path (relative to the workspace folder) or URL of an image. Put a value with a `#` between quotes. An `image` that the layout shows as the background takes precedence. Default: The background of the theme.
background.markdownDescription: The background of the slide: a CSS colour (`"#1e3a8a"`), a gradient (`"linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a8a, #9333ea)"`), or the path (relative to the workspace folder) or URL of an image. Put a value with a `#` between quotes. An `image` that the layout shows as the background takes precedence. Default: The background of the theme.

class.description: One or more CSS classes, separated by spaces, that are added to the `.slide__layout` element of the slide, so a custom theme can style it.
class.markdownDescription: One or more CSS classes, separated by spaces, that are added to the `.slide__layout` element of the slide, so a custom theme can style it.

video.description: Path (relative to the workspace folder) or URL of the video. A custom layout can use it too.
video.markdownDescription: Path (relative to the workspace folder) or URL of the video. A custom layout can use it too.

controls.description: Shows the video controls. Without controls, the video plays as a muted background that loops.
controls.markdownDescription: Shows the video controls. Without controls, the video plays as a muted background that loops.

autoplay.description: Starts the video, or the drawing of the animated SVG, when the slide opens. A video that starts automatically is muted. Default: `true`, or `false` for a video with `controls`.
autoplay.markdownDescription: Starts the video, or the drawing of the animated SVG, when the slide opens. A video that starts automatically is muted. Default: `true`, or `false` for a video with `controls`.

autoPlay.description: Another spelling of `autoplay` for the video layout.
autoPlay.markdownDescription: Another spelling of `autoplay` for the video layout.

loop.description: Loops a video with `controls`. A video without controls always loops.
loop.markdownDescription: Loops a video with `controls`. A video without controls always loops.

muted.description: Mutes a video with `controls` that doesn't start automatically. Other videos are always muted.
muted.markdownDescription: Mutes a video with `controls` that doesn't start automatically. Other videos are always muted.

playsInline.description: Plays a video with `controls` inline on mobile devices instead of full screen. A video without controls always plays inline.
playsInline.markdownDescription: Plays a video with `controls` inline on mobile devices instead of full screen. A video without controls always plays inline.

playbackRate.description: The playback speed of the video, like `0.5` or `2`.
playbackRate.markdownDescription: The playback speed of the video, like `0.5` or `2`.

svgFile.description: Path (relative to the workspace folder) of the SVG file to draw. Required.
svgFile.markdownDescription: Path (relative to the workspace folder) of the SVG file to draw. Required.

animationSpeed.description: Drawing speed in pixels per second. Higher values draw faster.
animationSpeed.markdownDescription: Drawing speed in pixels per second. Higher values draw faster.

textTypeWriterEffect.description: Types the text of the SVG character by character.
textTypeWriterEffect.markdownDescription: Types the text of the SVG character by character.

textTypeWriterSpeed.description: Typing speed in milliseconds per character. Lower values type faster.
textTypeWriterSpeed.markdownDescription: Typing speed in milliseconds per character. Lower values type faster.

skipAnimation.description: Shows the complete SVG right away, without drawing it.
skipAnimation.markdownDescription: Shows the complete SVG right away, without drawing it.

invertLightAndDarkColours.description: Inverts the light and dark colours of the SVG, for contrast on a dark theme.
invertLightAndDarkColours.markdownDescription: Inverts the light and dark colours of the SVG, for contrast on a dark theme.

controlsPosition.description: The position of the play, reset and skip controls, or `none` to hide them.
controlsPosition.markdownDescription: The position of the play, reset and skip controls, or `none` to hide them.
